name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 43 – Am 90
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 43a. Condemns the practice of surrogacy, which undermines the human dignity of women by reducing their bodies and reproductive functions to commodities; highlights its severe impact on women, their rights and their health, and underlines its significant cross-border implications; stresses that surrogacy is a phenomenon that exposes women worldwide to exploitation and human trafficking, particularly targeting those who are financially and socially vulnerable; believes that surrogacy, as a practice that exploits women’s bodies for reproductive purposes, should be banned, including in the case of vulnerable women in developing countries;
